sourceImage.subject: American robin (Turdus migratorius)
sourceImage.photographer: Courtney Celley / U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Midwest Region

blocks.caption: The earliest filters: edges and colour-contrast boundaries, still at full photo resolution.
Edges start combining into short strokes and simple textures.
Textures and local shapes: feathers, fur, foliage read as patterns here.
Parts of objects: the layer this project's fine-tuning starts from.
Whole-object structure, at the coarsest spatial resolution before the classifier head.
